scripts.export-full-resume: npx resume export -r full-resume.json -t jsonresume-theme-paper ErfanEivazi-Full.html
scripts.build-resume-win: npm run export-resume && (echo --- & echo layout: resume & echo --- & echo.) > resume.html && type ErfanEivazi.html >> resume.html
scripts.build-resume:
npm run export-resume && echo '---
layout: resume
---
' | cat - ErfanEivazi.html > resume.html
scripts.build-full-resume-win: npm run export-full-resume && (echo --- & echo layout: resume & echo --- & echo.) > full-resume.html && type ErfanEivazi-Full.html >> full-resume.html
scripts.build-full-resume:
npm run export-full-resume && echo '---
layout: resume
---
' | cat - ErfanEivazi-Full.html > full-resume.html
scripts.help: echo "Just open `ErfanEivazi.html` file with double click, modify image address and then press `ctrl+P` to create pdf file and save it."
